reviews.author: Greg Callow
reviews.text: We were thrilled with the service provided by Triple C. I found them based on Google Reviews and I now understand why they have such a high rating. We had our interior and exteriors windows cleaned. A quote was provided quickly and at a very reasonable price. Our technician arrived on time, was very respectful and did an outstanding job. Our windows look great!

reviews.author: Susan Richards
reviews.text: Chris powerwashed a 20 year old Trex deck with PVC railing that had been neglected and it looks brand new! Great attention to detail, I couldn't be happier. I highly reccomend them.

reviews.author: Marty Schayowitz
reviews.text: I couldn't be more impressed with Triple C Window and House Washing Services! They came out to our home yesterday, and from start to finish, the experience was top-notch. Their team was not only incredibly professional but also friendly and respectful of our space. They worked efficiently, and the results are absolutely fantastic! Our windows have never looked so crystal clear, and our home has never been this spotless! Plus, their pricing is very reasonable for the high-quality work they deliver. It's rare to find a service that ticks all the boxes, excellent work, great value, and amazing customer service. I highly recommend Triple C for anyone in need of window or house washing. They truly go above and beyond!

reviews.author: Tammy Boyd
reviews.text: Repeat customer here ALWAYS satisfied with my house getting power washed by Triple C! Highly recommend them for your next power wash too!

reviews.author: Jenel C
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Triple C. When I initially called to make my window cleaning appointment, I spoke with Nadine. She was wonderful, explaining everything in detail and going over several different options with me. She was very pleasant to speak with and followed our phone call up with a detailed email. Once I solidified the service, Chris came out to clean the windows at my home. Chris was great, he explained everything he was going to do before starting the job. The windows looked absolutely beautiful once they were done. I went with the full service , interior and exterior window cleaning. Great service, great price, friendly staff, highly recommend!

reviews.author: Ken Rasa
reviews.text: We have used Lesco as our plumbing, heating, and cooling provider for near 20 years now and not once have we ever been disappointed. Our technician Steve it’s always efficient and extremely helpful with recommendations. I highly recommend them to anybody that need services such as these.

reviews.author: Christopher Dolan
reviews.text: Triple C came to my home today for an entire home power washing. My home is basically all white and over the last few years it accumulated a dirty look. Within 3 hours my house was a beautiful white again. I would give this company an excellent rating. Very reasonable price and a great job.

reviews.author: Wendy Oshiro
reviews.text: I've used Dan to clean my windows for several years. This time I used him to clean my roof, had some algae growing, power wash the exterior of the house and wash all 28 windows. My house looks amazing. Dan and his team are thorough, meticulous, and the nicest guys you ever want to meet. They are safety conscious, and take pride in their work. Reasonably priced and well worth every cent. Their Customer Service is great too. Worked with me to get an appointment that fit my busy schedule. If you use Triple C you won't be disappointed.

reviews.author: Joseph Duchensky
reviews.text: I highly recommend Triple C Window Cleaning for their excellent job of power washing my house. They were extremely professional and thoroughly cleaned my home which had not been cleaned in many years. The vinyl siding looked bright and brand new after they were done. Dan and Mike who completed the job were great - they were very friendly and helpful. I would definitely use Triple C again in the future and give them an A+ for a job well done.

reviews.author: Michael Pollack
reviews.text: I have nothing but glowing things to say about Triple C. I'm not sure what the name of the company stands for, but I'd say the C's are: Caring, Customer-Focused, and Cleanly. Dan and Mike did excellent work earlier today at our property, and the power-washing seems to have taken years off of our house. We liked the work so much that we booked a roof clean/ lichen-removal service for a few weeks down the road. Everyone at the small company is top-notch. Nadine is friendly and detail-driven, and the staffers are professional and punctual. They took the time to explain the nature of the work and to perform it with great care; the results speak for themselves. I would recommend this company wholeheartedly.

reviews.author: Barbara Tejerina
reviews.text: It was a real pleasure to do business with Triple C. Getting an estimate and setting up an appointment for having my windows washed was a smooth and prompt process. Communication was excellent. The workers arrived right on time, introduced themselves, and explained what they were going to do. They were friendly and polite, as well as eager to address any concerns I had about specific areas (my house is 100 years old!). When they were done, all window treatments (curtains, drapery, blinds) were back in place, and the windows sparkled! I would not hesitate to recommend them, and I look forward to working with them again!

reviews.author: Amy Bartolotta
reviews.text: Very happy with my window cleaning by Triple C. Technician was very courteous and did a great job. He did not rush and made sure to get every spot on windows. I definitely would recommend and use them again. Amy B.

reviews.author: John Maggiulli Sr.
reviews.text: Chris did an outstanding job. He did our windows, house, garage and deck. His great work is one of the reasons we are a repeat customer.

reviews.author: Kimberly Winsch
reviews.text: We have an older house with light-colored vinyl siding that was in pretty desperate need of a good power washing. I called Triple C and was able to schedule a visit for the very next week. The day of service, the Triple C crew showed up promptly at the scheduled start time, and were professional, courteous, thorough, tidy, and efficient! They did a beautiful job, and we couldn't be more pleased with the outcome. I highly recommend Triple C!!!

reviews.author: Bobbie Hennessy
reviews.text: I’m very grateful to have chosen Triple C Pro Window Cleaners. They were on time, very efficient, friendly, they shared a good working relationship and my windows look beautiful! I think their pricing was very reasonable. I can check off the box for finding a good and reliable window cleaning business. I will be using them again and recommending them to my neighbors and friends.

reviews.author: Penny Jones
reviews.text: Chris, who power washed our house and deck was a delightful representative of Triple C, and he did an excellent job of power washing the house and the deck, as well as cleaning the windows.

reviews.author: Allison Bobby
reviews.text: Chris and Chris both came to clean the windows today. While cleaning the interior Chris (the owner) noticed a natural gas smell coming from my basement and immediately alerted me. I was in my office on the second floor and likely wouldn’t have noticed the gas until 5pm when my work day ended. I called the fire department and both Chris’s waited with me while the fire department and the utility company identified the source of the gas leak. They went above and beyond and even finished the job hours after their scheduled time. I highly recommend the quality of the cleaning that was done, but what really set them apart was their customer service and the fact that they were so willing to make sure everything was ok before leaving my house.

reviews.author: Ernest Villa
reviews.text: Triple C did a fantastic job!!! When I called I got a real person on the first call and an estimate that was accurate on that first call. We scheduled the work within 2 weeks and they arrived on time. They were very professional and friendly and did a great job. We plan to have them come in the Spring and Fall every year. It’s well worth the cost.

reviews.author: Cindy Wetter
reviews.text: Triple C did my townhouse windows and I couldn’t be happier. This is my second time using them and would highly recommend to anyone who wants to feel they are living outside because the windows are so clean!!

reviews.author: James Addis
reviews.text: The team of Sean and Joe sent by Triple C to wash our exterior windows (after removing, cleaning, and then re-installing every screen) were superb. They were careful, efficient, personable, and thoroughly detail-oriented in every aspect of the work they did. The result was a house that was flooded with light!

reviews.author: Carol D
reviews.text: Sean and Nick did an excellent job with the soft wash house wash and also with the window cleaning services. My house and windows look very clean and bright. The Triple C team were both professional, friendly, helpful. I highly recommend Triple C and especially Sean and Nick for house washing and window cleaning services.

reviews.author: Dave Allu
reviews.text: Great job by Nadine and Chris. The windows look SOO much better. They were neat, clean, courteous, prompt and quick, but did a really good and thorough job. We have ancient windows that clearly haven't been cleaned in possibly decades... and I did not think they could look as good as they do. I recommend them.

reviews.author: Jacquelyn Cully
reviews.text: We used Triple C for exterior gutter brightening services and the results were superb! Dan and Mike were were polite, competent and efficient. We could not have asked for a better job. Thank you for your excellent service and professionalism. We will certainly contact you again in the future when our gutters need attention!

reviews.author: Marie Hoffman
reviews.text: I'm a first time customer with Triple C Power Washing & Window Cleaning but this won't be the last time! They did an amazing job - they were professional, friendly, and double checked all their work. I highly recommend Triple C!!

reviews.author: Bernadette Ponticelli Szoke
reviews.text: Triple C arrived on time. All three gentlemen worked efficiently and fast (completed the power washing and all our windows inside and out in 2 hours - we have a ranch style home). All screens were returned to their original place and windows were closed and relocked. Home (inside and out) was left just as they came. Neat and tidy. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Jared Moretti
reviews.text: Dan and Chris did a great job power washing the exterior of my house. They went so far as to go on the roof to wash this one soffit that was very dirty and hard to reach. Then they pressure washed parts of my front porch that were covered with years' worth of mold and algae. They even washed my shed at no extra cost. Very pleased. I highly recommend Triple C's services to any homeowner.

reviews.author: Kristin Petry
reviews.text: Nadine and Chris have been a pleasure to work with. They are very professional and do great work. It's refreshing to see such a hard-working team. I'll definitely call them again for windows and other services.

reviews.author: Thomas J Heinz
reviews.text: Chris and Tom showed up when expected, explained the window cleaning process and made me feel very comfortable that they were professionals. Their work was neat and the windows sparkle. Thanks for a great job and we look forward to hiring you again.

reviews.author: Anya Singleton
reviews.text: Triple C Window Cleaning was punctual, and did an excellent and tidy job cleaning our windows. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Judith OConnor
reviews.text: These guys are great!! They came on time, did a superb job, cleaned up and most of all, they were kind and customer oriented. The house and windows look brand new!

reviews.author: Janelle Swift
reviews.text: D- Service. They did show up on time but beyond timeliness unfortunately the service was awful. Upon arrival they informed us that they would not remove and clean the double panes. After cleaning the outside of one window, I was asked if I was satisfied. I removed the double pain, cleaned it and asked them to rewash the outside because the corners still were not clean on the outside. They stated my expectations were unreasonable, packed up, and left. When I called the owner she simply wanted to argue instead of find a customer service solution. Very poor customer service. Highly NOT recommended.

reviews.author: Flora Brophy
reviews.text: Could not be happier with Triple C....responsive in responding to inquiry; work commenced on schedule; workers were professional and did a great job. Power washed deck and composite walk-way, soft-washed house and washed all windows, inside and out.

reviews.author: Bev McGregor
reviews.text: Very quick response time with estimate and completion of project. House, front porch, and palladian window came out beautiful! Would not hesitate to recommend Triple C to anyone looking for these services.

reviews.author: Robert Stoskus
reviews.text: Dan did a great job on the power washing of our house! So clean! His helper also was careful not to let the hoses break our plants. The stone patio came out so well it looks like new. What a difference!

reviews.author: Ray Roberts
reviews.text: Excellent job on the house and the windows. Siding looks brand new and windows came out perfect!! We will have you back in the future when our house needs powerwashing again!!

reviews.author: William Smith
reviews.text: We were referred by one of our neighbors for window cleaning. Terrific job on an older home. Very professional and reasonably priced. Would definitely use again.

reviews.author: Claudia Ionescu
reviews.text: A true 5 stars experience . From the scheduling, to the job itself( gutter cleaning and house wash). Everyone was friendly and professional. I am so happy I found Triple C. I will definitely use them in the future. Highly recommended it. Thks a lot !!!

reviews.author: Carson Remig
reviews.text: Chris and Nick were courteous, professional and neat while in and out of our home. The windows are now clear and beautiful. We will use this company again in the future.

reviews.author: Mike Swift
reviews.text: Was very clear about the need to clean windows with removable inserts. I was told that was part of the cleaning. When crew arrived they said they did not remove the insert and clean inside. We asked them to continue and do the outside and inside. After 20 minutes they decided they could not get the windows to appear clean because of the inserts and made a decision to refund our deposit without even discussing it with us. They did put things back together but left us handing with no window cleaning done at all.

reviews.author: Victoria Sacco Lamberti
reviews.text: Excellent service - thorough, professional. Our house looks like new! Will definitely be using Triple C's services again in the future and will recommend to others as well.

reviews.author: Marie Koch
reviews.text: Honest pricing. Work was done beautifully. Professional and meticulous work. Would nor hesitate to use them again and highly recommend these men to friends and family. THANKS FOR AN EXCELLENT JOB!

reviews.author: Jerry Filippini
reviews.text: I highly recommend Triple C Window Cleaning! They did a great job! Nadine and Chris were great!! I'll be using them regularly. Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Nancy Clark
reviews.text: They did an excellent job! My house looks brand new. Very professional, punctual and courteous. Would highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Tracy L
reviews.text: If you want your windows to sparkle, then call Nadine and Chris from Triple C Pro Window Cleaning! They are wonderful people and do a terrific job!

reviews.author: Marilyn Poskitt
reviews.text: Three wonderful young men did an outstanding job with our windows and power washing. Your company is very fortunate to have them in your employ.

reviews.author: Bjorg Hardardottir
reviews.text: The best window cleaners I've used so far. Great communication, great work. Neat and punctual. I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Michael Milano
reviews.text: Great service. Very careful powerwashing completed on my horrible looking concrete patios and walk way. Beautiful job. Much appreaciated. Will 100% recommend.

reviews.author: Lynnellen Klingener
reviews.text: excellent job as always and highly recommend Chris and Nadine to everyone. They are very personable and friendly and in and out before you know it. If there were 10 stars I would rate them a 10!!!

reviews.author: Ellen Erwood
reviews.text: I highly recommend Triple C! They did a fantastic job on our windows as well as being extremely polite and professional. Thanks again guys!

reviews.author: Allison Hester
reviews.text: Chris, Nadine, and their team are amazing! Great company. Very knowledgeable and professional. Fantastic quality work. I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Tammy Alofs
reviews.text: Competitive pricing! Very professional. Did a great job on the windows. Would definitely use them again!

reviews.author: Jenifer Gornstein
reviews.text: Great work. I highly recommend Triple C Pro Window Cleaning. I have tried other window cleaning service and there is no comparison.

reviews.author: Sima Patel
reviews.text: The windows were shiny & bright. The washers were polite, timely, & very detailed. I will be using them again in the future.

reviews.author: Michael Russo
reviews.text: Prompt and fast (but thorough) service - also very knowledgeable about my windows and screens, gave me a couple pro tips and what to look out for, and OMG I can see so clearly now!!

reviews.author: Philip Rogers
reviews.text: Triple C cleaned the windows in our rental in New Jersey and everything was terrific from start to finish!

reviews.author: ARLENE BARRA
reviews.text: Very professional. Arrived on time and did a fantastic job. Very pleased and recommend this company.

reviews.author: Lee Fleming
reviews.text: Had a wonderful experience with Triple C, Chris came out and did a fantastic job washing all of our windows inside and out. Both Chris and Nadine were so friendly, and we look forward to working with them again in the future!

reviews.author: Allie Cohen
reviews.text: Everyone at Triple C was extremely responsive, friendly, and easy to work with. Chris did interior and exterior window cleaning for us, and the windows look great.
